title: Vanillish
description: A Minecraft Modpack that aims to fine tune the game while keeping it 100% Vanilla.
body:
We all know the saying: "Mojang doesn't care about player input"
This modpack aims to build Minecraft from the ground up, while being Vanilla Friendly.

  An all new modpack dedicated to keeping the game vanilla while listening to the
community(Mojang take notes)!

  This modpack re-adds the mobs that have been removed and mobs that did not win a previous mob vote. As well as adding unique new boss fights and combat.
  
  As for terrain, it has been heavily improved using mods such as Teralith, Biomes 'O Plenty, Incindeum and Nullscape.
  Structure wise there are new and improved villages, enhanced structures such as the Ocean Monument and the Desert Temple. The End as well features new structures to give it the feel of the End update Mojang keeps avoiding.
 
  If anyone has any ideas or concerns about the modpack, let me know and I will do my best to fix it: [My GitHub](https://github.com/ItsAHotDog-cmd/Vanillish)
